title: Megurine Luka — Chalkboard Cherry Blossoms In Bloom〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, here's to completing our cherry blossom tree... Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa, take it easy!
You're gonna spill juice everywhere if you do that!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thanks for giving us a hand, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Nod*
You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I still can't believe how fun it is to look at these cherry blossoms. It's so clear that they're all drawn by different people.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
The ones KAITO drew look so real.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, they do. I was really impressed by the gradation he added while coloring everything in by using the white chalk.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me too. I was so surprised when I took a peek since I was drawing right next to him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I only ended up drawing a few...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I think Rin won in that department.
She even started some without lifting her chalk.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Because that lets me draw them faster!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I couldn't believe how fast you were. Just blam-blam-blam one after another!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I tried copying you but couldn't get the hang of it. Some ended up looking more like amoebas.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, the ones that made Shiho say, “No, redraw them,” after erasing them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, those were kind of...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I know...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, how about we really get our picnic going by breaking out the dango and rice cakes?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, there's food?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It wouldn't be much of a picnic otherwise. I asked Honami and the girls to prepare some for us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And here they are.
Tricolor dango and various kinds of rice cakes, including cherry blossom and sweet soybean flavors.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Nice! This is turning out to be a wonderful picnic!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll start distributing the paper plates and chopsticks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Where'd the napkins go?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, they should be in this bag.
Lemme get them out...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, these look so yummy.
Which should I eat first♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not sure where to start either. Do you know what you want, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think I'll start with a cherry blossom rice cake...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, sounds like a safe bet!
I'll do the same.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Honami, can you get two cherry blossom rice cakes for me and KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure. Just give me one second.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Looks like they're all having fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I'm glad I asked the girls to prepare some food for us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That was definitely a good idea, but I was talking more about our cherry blossoms.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We couldn't find any real cherry blossoms, but everyone's all smiles now thanks to you suggesting that we draw some.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
So thank you, Luka.
I had a lot of fun doing that as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (To be fair, Miku, you essentially gave me that idea.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I mean, all I did was draw the tree I saw in that strange and wondrous place.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (And I have a feeling that the tree I saw was still very young.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But the girls' feelings on those branches... They were shining so brightly.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (As long as they remain that bright, I'm sure that tree will continue to “grow”.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'd love to see what it looks like when it matures.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka, do you know what you want to eat?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you don't decide soon, Rin's going to eat all of them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?! I wouldn't do that!
Look, Luka! You still have a full assortment to choose from!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Let's see...
I think I'll have some tricolor dango.
